race.title: Matchbook Loves Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: MOLTO BENE developed a positive profile over fences in 2025/26, only just denied a third win of the campaign at Market Rasen in April, and having scored first time out the last 2 seasons she could be ready to add to her tally. King's Threshold is next on the list having had an excuse when last seen, ahead of Aboutdamntime . MOLTO BENE (IRE) KING'S THRESHOLD (IRE) ABOUTDAMNTIME (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Molto Bene (5/4), King's Threshold (7/2), Go To War (4/1), Aboutdamntime (11/2), Minniemum (10/1)
